default_realm.description: Default Kerberos realm name (all caps). Used when realm is not specified.

dns_lookup_realm.description: If true, attempt DNS lookup for realm using TXT records.

dns_lookup_kdc.description: If true, attempt DNS SRV lookup for KDCs using SRV records.

dns_fallback.description: If true, fall back to /etc/krb5.conf realms if DNS lookup fails.

clockskew.description: Maximum accepted time difference (in seconds) between client and KDC.

kdc_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for KDC contact attempts.

default_ccache_name.description: Default credential cache location pattern. %{uid} expands to the user ID.

renew_lifetime.description: Maximum renewal window for renewable tickets.

forwardable.description: Whether to issue forwardable tickets by default.

proxiable.description: Whether to issue proxiable tickets by default.

pk_init_anchors.description: List of paths to PKIX/SPKE KDC certificates for pkinit.

allow_weak_crypto.description: If true, allow DES and other weak ciphers (not recommended).

name.description: Realm name (case-insensitive; normalized to uppercase in config).

kdcs.description: List of KDC hostnames or URIs (e.g., ['kdc1.example.com', 'kdc2.example.com']).

admin_server.description: Host running the Kerberos administration service (kadmin).

default_domain.description: Default DNS domain associated with the realm.

pk_init_anchors.description: Realm-specific paths to PKIX KDC certificates.

pk_init_identity.description: PKIX client certificate identity for pkinit (e.g., 'FILE:/etc/krb5kdc/client.pem,FILE:/etc/krb5kdc/client.key').

domain_realm.description: Mapping of DNS domains to Kerberos realms.

realm.description: Kerberos realm to map the domain to.

kdc_listen.description: Network interfaces and ports the KDC listens on.

kdc_bind.description: Bind addresses for KDC (if different from listen addresses).

kdc_max_time_skew.description: Maximum accepted clock skew (seconds) for KDC operations.

kdc_profile.description: Path to config file for KDC-specific settings (often self-referential).

kdc_database.description: KDC database configuration (required for KDC deployment).

path.description: Path to the principal database file.

acls_file.description: ACL file for Kerberos administration permissions.

key_stash_file.description: File containing the master key stash.

mkey_file.description: File containing the master key (deprecated in some versions).

capaths.description: Cross-realm path definitions (e.g., for realm delegation).

path_realm.description: Intermediate realm used to traverse between from_realm and to_realm.

dbmodules.description: Database module overrides for advanced multi-backend setups.

library.description: Database backend library path or alias.

database_args.description: Additional arguments for the database backend.

parameters.description: List of key-value pairs to configure application behavior.
